cues.text: Your room in the dorm. Ryoji stands by the window, eyes closed, as you come in through the door. He opens his eyes and turns to face you.
You sit down beside each other on the bed.
Ryoji smiles, gets up from the bed and goes to stand by the window.
You stay seated a moment with your head bowed, then get up and go to stand in front of him.
Ryoji nods and closes his eyes. You lower your head, then raise your Evoker to your own temple. Everything goes white.

Ryoji gets up, walks to the middle of the room and turns to face you. Light bursts from his chest and swallows him in a pillar of light. When it fades, a tall masked figure hangs in the air where he stood, huge blade-like wings spread at its back.
In a flash the figure is gone, and Ryoji stands there again, smiling.
You sit a moment with your head bowed, then get up and walk over to Ryoji.
Ryoji nods and closes his eyes. You lower your head, then raise your Evoker to your own temple. Everything goes white.
In a flash the masked figure is gone, and Ryoji stands there again.
Ryoji holds out a small music box, and you take it.
